'''Raven Squadron''' was a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots, flying [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], that attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]] and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] over [[Destreg II]].
